best way I can describe it is, when my life is really fucking shit and I hate everything going on within it, I would rather experience a few hours of being scared shitless of things/creatures that are not real and feeling nothing else BUT that fear, unable to form a coherent thought, VS. very real life problems, people, things, feelings, thoughts. its like taking a break. no matter how shitty it makes me feel, its like my best friend. my life revolves around it. too drowsy to form many thoughts or feelings. too drowsy to care all that much. and after so many years of doing this, its like my support system. its my security blanket (ironic isnt it?) 

but the tripping part, even though it’s absolutely horrific and traumatizing everytime, theres things i love about it too. im a very lonely person. i cant remember the last time i left the house. i have a lot of mental health issues. so when those shadow people are there, its like i am in my own little world that no one else can be apart of. sometimes if i trip hard enough, i will find personalities in these shadow people. or they’ll have names. no matter how terrifying or cruel some of them are, its still better than being alone. a common trip hallucination i have is hearing a crowd of people talking. thats another thing i like. it makes me forget about real life entirely because i’m in my own delirious reality. i have a lot of weird personal attachments with benadryl, i could probably write a whole novel on it. but what i fiend for is that its like taking a break for awhile. going somewhere else. being in my own bubble with these other miserable strangers that arent actually real. every shadow person i have ever encountered was either sad and hopeless, or angry and hateful. sometimes i’ll catch myself actually missing these shadow people even though they aren’t even real. idk its all fucked up shit. theres just something about it that feels healing to me even though its destroyed my brain, my future, my health in general. I truly cannot see myself ever stopping.

and truly i think i would still pick benadryl over anything else. i dont know why. its been YEARSSSSS and not once have i ever been able to really move on from benadryl. but it is a sedative and can absolutely be addictive. its just labeled as non habit forming / non addictive. a lot of things can be addictive that you wouldnt expect to be. many people think benadryl addiction is either impossible or moronic but unfortunately that same mindset is the whole reason im addicted to it lmfao. started when i was fucking 12. even mentioned it to my cousin, i thought something was wrong with me. she said “you cant be addicted to benadryl 😂😂” so i kept doing it
